findings.fact: import export targets dist/esm/i18next.js; CommonJS distribution recorded separately; installed version26.4.3/MIT.
EventEmitter tracks callback identity; off(event) deletes all event listeners, off(event, callback) removes that callback. App wrappers give distinct owner identity.
addResourceBundle copies by default, deep-merges when requested and emits actual added(lng, ns, resources) unless silent.
init calls load immediately for inline resources or initAsync false, but returns deferred Promise.
changeLanguage sets current language and emits actual languageChanged before resolving its deferred. Application latest queue controls UI publication, not an SDK cancellation API.
getFixedT attaches fixed language to call options unless explicitly overridden; committed-language rendering can remain distinct from observed SDK state.
ResourceStore added/removed on/off, getFixedT, languageChanged and addResourceBundle signatures match app calls.
escapeValue, returnDetails and initAsync are actual options; escaping is interpolation, not arbitrary HTML sanitization.
returnDetails true maps to detailed result type.

scope: Read-only installed types/source audit. No fresh SDK/browser run. Cleanup claim limited to application owned callbacks and UI queue publication; no SDK destroy/abort/global census.
